def headers = [:]
headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
headers['Accept'] = 'application/json'
headers['x_perf_test'] = (_global?.global_params?.threadContext?.perfFlag ?: 'false').toString()
headers['x_ims_client_id'] = (_global?.global_params?.threadContext?.clientId ?: '').toString()
headers['x_ims_tenant'] = (_global?.global_params?.threadContext?.tenant ?: '').toString()
headers['x_ims_username'] = (_global?.global_params?.threadContext?.userName ?: '').toString()
headers['X_RESTBUS_MESSAGE_ID'] = (_global?.nodeParameters?.messageId ?: java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString()).toString()
def groupId = _global?.nodeParameters?.groupId
if (groupId != null && !groupId.toString().trim().isEmpty()) {
    headers['X_RESTBUS_GROUP_ID'] = groupId.toString()
}
headers['X_RESTBUS_HTTP_URI'] = (_global?.nodeParameters?.httpUri ?: '').toString()
headers['X_RESTBUS_HTTP_METHOD'] = (_global?.nodeParameters?.method ?: 'POST').toString()
def extraHeaders = _global?.nodeParameters?.extraHeaders
if (extraHeaders instanceof Map) {
    extraHeaders.each { k, v -> headers[k.toString()] = v?.toString() ?: '' }
}
return headers
